WEBSITE INFORMATION / OCTOBER 21, 2026

Privacy
policy.

Information you enter

The request preparation tool runs in your browser. It does not send form details to Square State Towing or store them on a website server. If you choose to open an email draft, the details are passed to your selected email application. You decide whether to send that email.

Calls and email

Telephone and email links open the relevant application on your device. Information you choose to share by phone or email is handled through those services. For questions about company handling or retention of correspondence, contact squarestatetowing@gmail.com.

Local preferences

The logo entrance remembers a skip decision using local storage on your device and avoids repeating during the same browser session. It has no audio. Clear your site data to remove local preferences.

Hosting and external sites

The hosting provider processes ordinary request information needed to serve and protect the website. Links to Google and other external destinations use those services, which have their own privacy policies. This site includes no advertising trackers, analytics scripts, or embedded maps.

Contact

Privacy questions: squarestatetowing@gmail.com or (719) 399-3919.
